description: Returns Aidoptio services (price model and amount in EUR excl. VAT, duration, deliverables), ready-to-deploy products and published articles, with canonical English and Dutch URLs. Filter by section and language; limit caps the items per section (default 50).

section.description: Return one section only. Omit for all four.
